content:
# Queenstown Lakeview Hotel Cancellation & Refund Policy

- Cancel 48+ hours before check-in: full refund, no charge.
- Cancel 24-48 hours before check-in: 50% cancellation fee of the total room charge.
- Cancel within 24 hours of check-in or no-show: full room charge applies, no refund.
- Stays disrupted by force majeure (severe weather, road closures) may be fully refunded or rebooked free of charge upon hotel verification.
- All refunds are returned to the original payment method within 7-10 business days.

# Rotorua Thermal Hotel Cancellation & Refund Policy

- Cancel 24+ hours before check-in: full refund, no charge.
- Cancel within 24 hours of check-in: 100% cancellation fee, no refund.
- No-show: full room charge applies.
- If the geothermal area is temporarily closed, guests unable to stay will receive a full refund and assistance finding an equivalent hotel nearby.

# Auckland Harbour Hotel Cancellation & Refund Policy

- Cancel 72+ hours before check-in: full refund, no charge.
- Cancel within 72 hours of check-in: 30% cancellation fee of the total room charge.
- No-show: 50% cancellation fee of the total room charge.
- Guests whose flights or ferries are cancelled due to severe weather may cancel or rebook free of charge once with proof.

# Test Auckland CBD Hotel Cancellation & Refund Policy

- Cancel 48+ hours before check-in: full refund, no charge.
- Cancel within 48 hours of check-in: 25% cancellation fee of the total room charge.
- No-show: one night's room charge applies as a penalty.

# Queenstown Central Park Hotel Cancellation & Refund Policy

- Cancel 48+ hours before check-in: full refund, no charge.
- Cancel 24-48 hours before check-in: 50% cancellation fee of the total room charge.
- Cancel within 24 hours of check-in or no-show: full room charge applies, no refund.
- Guests staying while the ski fields are closed due to weather may rebook free of charge once.

# Queenstown Alpine Lodge Cancellation & Refund Policy

- Cancel 72+ hours before check-in: full refund, no charge.
- Cancel within 72 hours of check-in: 30% cancellation fee of the total room charge.
- No-show: 30% of the total room charge applies as a penalty.
- Guests unable to arrive due to mountain road closures will receive a full refund with an official notice.

# Auckland SkyTower Suites Cancellation & Refund Policy

- Cancel 24+ hours before check-in: full refund, no charge.
- Cancel within 24 hours of check-in: 50% cancellation fee of the total room charge.
- No-show: the first night's room charge plus taxes applies.

# Auckland Airport Gateway Hotel Cancellation & Refund Policy

- Cancel 48+ hours before check-in: full refund, no charge.
- Cancel within 48 hours of check-in: 25% cancellation fee of the total room charge.
- Guests unable to stay due to cancelled or delayed flights may receive a full refund or rebook free of charge with a boarding pass or airline certificate.
- No-show: the first night's room charge applies.

# Wellington Harbourfront Hotel Cancellation & Refund Policy

- Cancel 72+ hours before check-in: full refund, no charge.
- Cancel within 72 hours of check-in: 40% cancellation fee of the total room charge.
- No-show: 40% of the total room charge applies as a penalty.
- Guests staying while ferries are suspended may rebook free of charge once.

# Wellington CBD Grand Hotel Cancellation & Refund Policy

- Cancel 48+ hours before check-in: full refund, no charge.
- Cancel within 48 hours of check-in: 50% cancellation fee of the total room charge.
- No-show: full room charge applies, no refund.

# Christchurch Riverside Hotel Cancellation & Refund Policy

- Cancel 24+ hours before check-in: full refund, no charge.
- Cancel within 24 hours of check-in or no-show: full room charge applies, no refund.
- In emergencies (earthquake, flooding) where the hotel cannot operate normally, guests receive a full refund and relocation assistance.

# Rotorua Lakeside Resort Cancellation & Refund Policy

- Cancel 72+ hours before check-in: full refund, no charge.
- Cancel within 72 hours of check-in: 30% cancellation fee of the total room charge.
- No-show: 30% of the total room charge applies as a penalty.
- Guests staying during a lake algal bloom warning may apply for a full refund.
